csv_project_name: Engineering for Hegewisch Station Grade Crossing Warning
csv_scope_of_work: The Northern Indiana Commuter Transportation District ( District ) is seeking professional services to include engineering and design for the Hegewisch Station Pedestrian/Pathway Crossings at each end of the platforms on NICTD Main Track 2. NICTD desires to enhance the current Hegewisch Station Pedestrian/Pathway Crossings at each end of the platforms on NICTD Main Track 2. Hegewisch Station Pedestrian/Pathway grade crossings are located within CP 70.5 interlocking limits on the SSL Lakeshore Corridor, Hegewisch, Illinois. The current crossings utilize a passive warning system. The design effort in this work scope will provide NICTD with new active grade crossing warning systems at these two (2) single track crossings on NICTD Main Track 2. The project will also provide an increased speed through the area that will require updates to the existing grade crossing warning system on both Mains Tracks at Burnham Ave.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Inspection Services, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, ITS Design, Public Transit Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning
